product.name: Portable Blender
product.usage: Add soft fruit and liquid, then press one button to blend a single-serving drink.
core_selling_points: Portable and convenient for busy routines
Quick smoothie prep without using a full-size blender
functional_claims: Suitable for smoothies, protein shakes, and soft fruit drinks
usage_scenarios: Quick fruit drink at office desk
product.target_use_moment: Busy morning or post-workout drink prep

audience.primary: Busy women aged 22-35 interested in fitness, wellness, and convenient routines
audience.secondary: Office workers, commuters, gym-goers, and students
pain_points: Fresh drinks feel hard to make during busy routines
motivations: Make healthy drinks without a complex setup
objections: May worry the product is hard to clean
May doubt whether the small size is useful

content_goal.objective: Drive product clicks and purchase interest through a creator-native TikTok Shop demo.

creative_direction.creator_type: Fitness or busy office lifestyle creator

avoid: Hard ice or frozen chunk claims unless shown

notes: Keep cup shape, lid design, and base silhouette consistent across scenes.
